# Himanshu Gunwant

> Developer · Builder · Student @ IIIT Tiruchirappalli. Minimalist portfolio and writing by Himanshu Gunwant.

## About

Computer Science undergraduate at IIIT Tiruchirappalli, interested in building products, backend systems, and exploring how things work under the hood.

I enjoy solving problems, experimenting with ideas, and building software that's simple, reliable, and useful.

## Projects

- [Relay X](https://himanshugunwant.com/projects/relay-x): A mobile companion for remote development and autonomous AI coding workflows. Real-time telemetry, agent streaming, and remote control. (Flutter · Fastify · WebSockets · TypeScript) | GitHub: https://github.com/himanshu-gunwant/Relay-X
- [Paste](https://himanshugunwant.com/projects/paste): A modern, production-grade paste-sharing application featuring atomic burn-after-read, revision diffing, and developer APIs. (Next.js 15 · Express 5 · PostgreSQL · Redis) | Live: https://paste.himanshugunwant.com | GitHub: https://github.com/himanshu-gunwant/Paste
